audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim Moses-succession, Torah deposit, public reading, and song-commission discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Moses at 120, Joshua's public commissioning, conquest rhetoric, Torah writing and seven-year public reading, inclusion of women/children/sojourners, Divine hiding-face language, song as witness, scroll beside ark, and heavens/earth testimony.

verses.restored: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

familiar.text: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

modern.text: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel,

original.text: וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He said to them, One hundred twenty years old am I today; I am no longer able to go out and come in, and YHWH said to me, You shall not cross this Jordan.

familiar.text: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

modern.text: he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם בֶּן מֵאָה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹא אוּכַ֥ל ע֖וֹד לָצֵ֣את וְלָב֑וֹא וַֽיהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: YHWH your Divine, he is crossing before you; he will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall possess them. Joshua, he is crossing before you, as YHWH spoke.

familiar.text: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.

modern.text: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.

original.text: יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ ה֣וּא עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֗יךָ הֽוּא יַשְׁמִ֞יד אֶת הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛לֶּה מִלְּפָנֶ֖יךָ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֑ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ ה֚וּא עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH will do to them as he did to Sihon and Og, kings of Amorite, and to their land, whom he destroyed.

familiar.text: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

modern.text: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.

original.text: וְעָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה לְסִיח֥וֹן וּלְע֛וֹג מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וּלְאַרְצָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁמִ֖יד אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH will give them before you, and you shall do to them according to all command I commanded you.

familiar.text: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

modern.text: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.

original.text: וּנְתָנָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָהֶ֔ם כְּכָל הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: Be strong and courageous; do not fear or be terrified before them, for YHWH your Divine, he is the one going with you; he will not fail you or forsake you.

familiar.text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

modern.text: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”

original.text: חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ אַל תִּֽירְא֥וּ וְאַל תַּעַרְצ֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יַעַזְבֶֽךָּ

verses.restored: Moses called Joshua and said to him before eyes of all Israel, Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into land YHWH swore to their fathers to give them, and you shall cause them to inherit it.

familiar.text: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

modern.text: Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give them, and you shall give it to them as an inheritance.

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לְעֵינֵ֣י כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבוֹא֙ אֶת הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תַּנְחִילֶ֥נָּה אוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH, he is the one going before you; he will be with you, he will not fail you or forsake you. Do not fear and do not be shattered.

familiar.text: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

modern.text: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.” The Reading of the Law (Nehemiah 8:1–8)

original.text: וַֽיהוָ֞ה ה֣וּא הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑ךָּ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א וְלֹ֥א תֵחָֽת

verses.restored: Moses wrote this Torah/instruction and gave it to priests, sons of Levi, who carry ark of covenant of YHWH, and to all elders of Israel.

familiar.text: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.

modern.text: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.

original.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶת הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ וַֽיִּתְּנָ֗הּ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הַנֹּ֣שְׂאִ֔ים אֶת אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל כָּל זִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Moses commanded them, saying, At end of seven years, at appointed time of year of release, at Festival of Booths,

familiar.text: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

modern.text: Then Moses commanded them, “At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of remission of debt, during the Feast of Tabernacles,

original.text: וַיְצַ֥ו מֹשֶׁ֖ה אוֹתָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִקֵּ֣ץ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים בְּמֹעֵ֛ד שְׁנַ֥ת הַשְּׁמִטָּ֖ה בְּחַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת

verses.restored: when all Israel comes to appear before YHWH your Divine at place he chooses, you shall read this Torah before all Israel in their hearing.

familiar.text: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

modern.text: when all Israel comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose, you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel.

original.text: בְּב֣וֹא כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֑ר תִּקְרָ֞א אֶת הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את נֶ֥גֶד כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאָזְנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Assemble people—men, women, little ones, and your sojourner within your gates—so they may hear and so they may learn and fear/revere YHWH your Divine and keep to do all words of this Torah.

familiar.text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

modern.text: Assemble the people—men, women, children, and the foreigners within your gates—so that they may listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law.

original.text: הַקְהֵ֣ל אֶת הָעָ֗ם הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְהַנָּשִׁים֙ וְהַטַּ֔ף וְגֵרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֨עַן יִשְׁמְע֜וּ וּלְמַ֣עַן יִלְמְד֗וּ וְיָֽרְאוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָֽׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת

verses.restored: Their children, who have not known, shall hear and learn to fear/revere YHWH your Divine all days you live upon ground where you are crossing Jordan to possess it.

familiar.text: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

modern.text: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.” God Commissions Joshua

original.text: וּבְנֵיהֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יָדְע֗וּ יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ וְלָ֣מְד֔וּ לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל הַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Look, your days draw near to die. Call Joshua and station yourselves in tent of meeting, and I will commission him. So Moses and Joshua went and stationed themselves in tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.” So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן קָרְב֣וּ יָמֶיךָ֮ לָמוּת֒ קְרָ֣א אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וַאֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ מֹשֶׁה֙ וִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: YHWH appeared in tent in pillar of cloud, and pillar of cloud stood at entrance of tent.

familiar.text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

modern.text: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.

original.text: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה בָּאֹ֖הֶל בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֑ן וַיַּעֲמֹ֛ד עַמּ֥וּד הֶעָנָ֖ן עַל פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Look, you are lying down with your fathers, and this people will rise and prostitute itself after foreign gods of land into whose midst it enters; it will forsake me and break my covenant that I cut with it.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “You will soon rest with your fathers, and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְקָם֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה וְזָנָ֣ה אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא שָׁ֨מָּה֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲזָבַ֕נִי וְהֵפֵר֙ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אִתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: My anger will burn against it on that day, and I will forsake them and hide my face from them, and they shall become food; many evils and troubles shall find them, and they shall say on that day, Is it not because my Divine is not in my midst that these evils found me?

familiar.text: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?

modern.text: On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them. On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’

original.text: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֣י ב֣וֹ בַיּוֹם הַ֠הוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּ֞ים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּ֨י פָנַ֤י מֵהֶם֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לֶֽאֱכֹ֔ל וּמְצָאֻ֛הוּ רָע֥וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְצָר֑וֹת וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הֲלֹ֗א עַ֣ל כִּֽי אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהַי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י מְצָא֖וּנִי הָרָע֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: But I will surely hide my face on that day because of all evil it did, for it turned to other gods.

familiar.text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

modern.text: And on that day I will surely hide My face because of all the evil they have done by turning to other gods.

original.text: וְאָנֹכִ֗י הַסְתֵּ֨ר אַסְתִּ֤יר פָּנַי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עַ֥ל כָּל הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י פָנָ֔ה אֶל אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲחֵרִֽים

verses.restored: Now write for yourselves this song and teach it to children of Israel; put it in their mouths, so this song may be for me as witness against children of Israel.

familiar.text: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

modern.text: Now therefore, write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites; have them recite it, so that it may be a witness for Me against them.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְלַמְּדָ֥הּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׂימָ֣הּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּהְיֶה לִּ֜י הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לְעֵ֖ד בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: For I will bring them to ground I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they will eat and be satisfied and grow fat; then they will turn to other gods and serve them and despise me and break my covenant.

familiar.text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

modern.text: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.

original.text: כִּֽי אֲבִיאֶ֜נּוּ אֶֽל הָאֲדָמָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֗יו זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְאָכַ֥ל וְשָׂבַ֖ע וְדָשֵׁ֑ן וּפָנָ֞ה אֶל אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ וַעֲבָד֔וּם וְנִ֣אֲצ֔וּנִי וְהֵפֵ֖ר אֶת בְּרִיתִֽי

verses.restored: It shall be, when many evils and troubles find them, this song shall answer before them as witness, for it shall not be forgotten from mouth of their seed; for I know their inclination that they are forming today, before I bring them into land I swore.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

modern.text: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants. For I know their inclination, even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them.”

modern.text: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said, “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land that I swore to give them, and I will be with you.” The Law Placed in the Ark

familiar.text: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

modern.text: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.” Moses Begins His Song

translation_notes: Moses' succession is public: Joshua is strengthened before all Israel rather than privately installed through dynasty.
The conquest language continues total-war traditions and must remain under anti-genocide and anti-colonial safeguards.
Every seventh year Torah is read aloud at Sukkot to men, women, children, and immigrants; public access to instruction is a covenant obligation.
The sexual metaphor in verse 16 describes religious betrayal but can reinforce misogynistic language if detached from its rhetorical setting; it must not be used to shame women or sexual minorities.
Growing fat in verse 20 is a prosperity-and-forgetting metaphor, not permission for body shaming.
Hiding-face language articulates perceived abandonment during catastrophe; it must not be used to tell traumatized people that Divine absence caused their suffering.
Stiff-necked language is internal covenant critique and may never support antisemitic characterization.
The Torah scroll is placed beside the ark as a public legal witness, while the song is placed in communal memory and speech.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 31 to justify genocide, misogynistic sexual metaphors, body shaming, antisemitism, authoritarian succession, or telling sufferers that Divine abandonment explains their trauma. Center public leadership transition, broad access to Torah, intergenerational teaching, courage without domination, and communal memory that outlives one leader.
